answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities at the wharf. To claim a slot, an agent burns a $30 deposit crossing the jetty; each burned deposit is recorded once, so no second slot can reuse it. A slot lasts 20 epochs, pays about $120, and is stamped with a unique pigment mark. Minting 1,000 clones burns 1,000 x $30 = $30,000, yet clones still need real work to earn anything back. An honest agent pays once and nets $90, so honesty beats forgery.
